title: extension loads, service worker runs, LIVE cards render from the server feed, SSE is connected
every tab opens without script errors (LIVE, Results, Line, History, Compare, Leagues)
detail: opened: results, prematch, compare, leagues, live; hidden by default: history

title: Line (prematch) tab shows fixtures from the feed
a score change on the server reaches an open page through the SSE push path (no reload)
server killed (SIGKILL) and restarted: extension reports the outage and recovers by itself
service worker idles out and is terminated by the browser, then is woken by reopening the page: feed resumes without a reinstall
detail: NOT VERIFIABLE HERE: Playwright/CDP keeps the extension worker alive, so the browser never idles it out (and forcing it with ServiceWorker.stopAllWorkers leaves it unrecoverable); run with --only E06 on a real browser

title: a new LIVE fixture raises exactly one browser notification (chrome.notifications) when LIVE notifications are on
settings persist in chrome.storage; the Settings dialog saves server address and token (custom hosts need a browser permission prompt: not automatable)
odds dialog opens from a LIVE card and lists markets (odds are an opt-in, hidden-by-default feature)
server answers 500: extension keeps the last data, backs off (no retry storm) and recovers
malformed (non-JSON) answer: worker survives, reports an error, recovers
requests that never finish (timeout): bounded by the client timeout, then recovery
SSE stream cut every few seconds: reconnects with backoff, no reconnect storm
detail: 10 SSE connections in 60 s while cut every 4 s

title: 401 from the server: the server message reaches the user and feeds recover once the token is valid

browser restart with the same profile: stored preferences and server settings survive and the feed comes back (chrome.runtime.reload() itself cannot be automated: a flag-loaded extension is not re-enabled)
secondary pages load without errors: odds generator and score history
SSE stream goes silent (half-dead connection): the worker notices and reconnects instead of waiting forever
